program.blurb: The lower body every day, never the same twice: legs, glutes, hips, calves and single-leg work in new formats.
program.about: The lower body every day, never the same session twice. Each day deals legs, the lower body, glutes and hips, calves and shins, single-leg work, the back of the body, bodyweight legs or glutes, kettlebell legs, hips or swings, or jumps and skips, each in a different format. The same kind never lands two days running. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
